title: NFL Draft Chime
blurb: The NFL draft chime — the broadcast sting meaning a pick is in and someone's life is about to change on live television. Sports edits lean on it constantly, but the meme value is far broader: it works for any selection at all. Choosing a restaurant, picking teams at recess, deciding who has to phone the landlord. The sound carries a bureaucratic finality, as though a decision has been formally lodged and can no longer be appealed. The pick is in.
origin: The 'pick is in' broadcast chime from NFL Draft coverage.
